function: UC8 - Process Amendment to Confirmed Booking

history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of Process Amendment to Confirmed Booking function.
features: In UC8, the Carrier reviews the booking amendment and decides whether to “Confirm” or “Decline” the proposed changes. UC8 is allowed only after UC7 has been received, and only the UC7 record in DCSA Booking Activity can be processed.

A new right-click option [Amendment Confirmed] is provided in DCSA Booking Activity. The system asks the agency user for remarks and confirms the amendment. When the user chooses this option, the required amendment has already been made in the AFSYS+ booking. The system calls:
•	PKG_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS.PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS, passing the feedback remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, which calls WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT and passes the user remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to AMENDMENT CONFIRMED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status is updated to CONFIRMED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].
•	DCSA amendment status is updated to AMENDMENT CONFIRMED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_AMENDMENT_STATUS].

A new right-click option [Amendment Declined] is provided in DCSA Booking Activity. The system asks the agency user for remarks and declines the shipper’s UC7 booking amendment request. The system calls:
•	PKG_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS.PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS, passing the feedback remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, which calls WEBEDI.DCSA_SHPMT_EVENT_LINKAGE.SHPMT_EVENT_DETAILS_INSERT and passes the user remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to AMENDMENT DECLINED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status keeps its previous status [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].
•	DCSA amendment status is updated to AMENDMENT DECLINED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_AMENDMENT_STATUS].

events.description: Opens the "Amendment Confirmed" pop-up for the selected booking request.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Amendment Confirmed" in the row's ☰ menu in the DCSA Activity grid.
events.remarks: "Do you want to Amendment Confirmed this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

events.description: Blocks the action if the record is not a UC7 (amendment received) record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Amendment Confirmed" and the precondition is not met.

events.description: Calls PKG_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS.PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS and PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT with the remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS; updates current event = AMENDMENT CONFIRMED, status = CONFIRMED, amendment status = AMENDMENT CONFIRMED.
events.triggered_when: User enters the reason and clicks Yes.

events.description: Opens the "Amendment Declined" pop-up for the selected booking request.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Amendment Declined" in the row's ☰ menu in the DCSA Activity grid.
events.remarks: "Do you want to Amendment Declined this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

events.description: Blocks the action if the record is not a UC7 (amendment received) record.
events.triggered_when: User clicks "Amendment Declined" and the precondition is not met.

events.description: Calls PKG_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS.PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS and PKG_DCSA_EBK_EVENT_TRIGGERING.PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT with the remarks in P_FEEDBACK_DETAILS; updates current event = AMENDMENT DECLINED, status unchanged, amendment status = AMENDMENT DECLINED.
events.triggered_when: User enters the reason and clicks Yes.

rows.name: Amendment Confirmed
rows.ui: Opens the Amendment Confirmed pop-up; allowed only for a UC7 (amendment received) record
rows.remarks: Calls TEMP2 process and event triggering on Yes

rows.name: Confirmation Text
rows.ui: Shows the selected DCSA Request ID
rows.values: "Do you want to Amendment Confirmed this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

rows.name: Reason for Amendment Confirmed
rows.ui: Input the reason for amendment confirmation

rows.name: Yes
rows.ui: Confirms the amendment: calls PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS and PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, then updates the status to AMENDMENT CONFIRMED / CONFIRMED

rows.name: Amendment Declined
rows.ui: Opens the Amendment Declined pop-up; allowed only for a UC7 (amendment received) record
rows.remarks: Calls TEMP2 process and event triggering on Yes

rows.name: Confirmation Text
rows.ui: Shows the selected DCSA Request ID
rows.values: "Do you want to Amendment Declined this booking request (<DCSA Request ID>)?"

rows.name: Reason for Amendment Declined
rows.ui: Input the reason for amendment decline

rows.name: Yes
rows.ui: Declines the amendment: calls PRC_DCSA_TEMP2_PROCESS and PRC_DCSA_POOL_INSERT, then updates the amendment status to AMENDMENT DECLINED (DCSA status unchanged)
